notes.title: Dev Update: Almost There! Breeze of Passion DLC Progress!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/a537b55c1e1c971a3f929544f109998e0e48e4de.jpg[/img]

Hello there, everyone!

Today, we have several exciting updates about the Breeze of Passion DLC for you.

As we mentioned earlier, this expansion promises to be big and packed with content. The story will revolve around a hotel inspection that, of course, quickly spirals out of control. You'll have to act fast and think outside the box to save the hotel and not let the beloved Emma down. The inspector will turn out to be a real challenge — cold, bold, and sharp-tongued. But we believe this task is well within your power — after all, you know exactly how to win over even the most unapproachable ladies.

Every decision you make will matter. To save the hotel, you might need to resort to different methods: spying, blackmail, or seduction — the choice is yours.

As always, loyal and stunning beauties will be by your side, ready to help. But don’t forget — even their help comes at a price, and how you’ll pay for it is up to you.

And, of course, in the best traditions of our games, you’ll be treated to steamy scenes with your favorite MILFs, as well as fiery encounters with new and equally breathtaking ones.

Now a bit about development. Right now, we’re in the final stage. A huge amount of animations, scenes, and mocap videos have been created and are currently undergoing meticulous polishing: artworks are being refined, animations improved, sound effects added, and visual details perfected. As soon as we complete the visual part, we'll move on to coding and thorough bug testing to ensure you can enjoy the game without anything distracting you.

And here’s more great news. Now that most of the material is ready, we’re starting to treat you to fresh spoilers! The first one is already featured as the cover image for this post. In the coming days, we’ll be posting more sneak peeks to let you feel the atmosphere of the upcoming update we’ve been working so hard on.

The wait is almost over — just one final push remains, and very soon,  you’ll be able to fully enjoy all this magnificent content!

We are deeply grateful for your patience, support, and trust in the project. Thanks to you, Breeze of Passion is becoming exactly what we envisioned — vivid, rich, and unforgettable.

Stay with us — and thank you for being such an amazing community! 🔥
With love, from all of our development team!

notes.title: Breeze of Passion: v7 has been released!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We're here to announce the release of the next update for "[b]Breeze of Passion[/b]"!

It's especially big and spicy and features a lot of progress in multiple story lines.

This update includes over [b]2100 images[/b] and [b]many hot animations[/b].

Just like in MILFs of Sunville, you can now change the speed of animations, and the Lovebar was implemented into the game. Every girl likes her own rhythm, make them all happy!

[h3]Added languages:[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Polish
[*]     Arabic
[/list]

The next update will be the final one for Breeze of Passion, thus completing the game!

Please enjoy this update and wait for the game's final scenes that will bring you even more pleasure!

[b]Our team will continue working hard for you, our beloved fans.[/b]

[b]Thank you for your support, everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/49df482c8b67b3a96ae33845ec6f1df151608d6b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Deck support
notes.content:
We've made adaptations to the game for Steam Deck devices.

[list]
[*] Native launch without Proton
[*] Text readability on Steam Deck
[*] The ability to play without using the touchscreen
[*] Launching the Event List, Smartphone, Map, and other features using gamepad buttons
[*] Map and in-game screen navigation using the joysticks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/b3c54edd1ee7a9933517c80d74ed9cf73cb403df.png[/img]

notes.title: Breeze of Passion: v2 has been released!
notes.content:
Hello there!

We're happy to announce the next update for our fresh game "[b]Breeze of Passion[/b]"!

The new version of the game also contains a ton of positive emotions, humor, and female beauty, of course!
